description: List address checks, newest first, a page at a time: filter by `address` (letter case ignored), `contactId`, `runId` (one batch), `state` or `status` (the verdict). A check is kept 30 days after it ends.

address.description: Only the checks of this address, letter case ignored.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

name: list_email_checks
title: List address checks
